results.name: Rolypolies debut in Level 2 wave 2 with their hint, and come back in L2 W5, L2 W8 and L3 W7
A credited touch curls it, it rolls away from the touch as a ghost, bowls pins as credited chains, then blooms
A roll plays out the same at 30, 60 and 144 FPS
A chain, a power or an uncredited strike blooms it plainly, with no roll
Seeds pass through a rolling rolypoly, and a roll aimed at the line turns back without costing a life
A Lullaby freezes a roll where it is, and it carries on after
The bot values a rolypoly by the pins its roll would cross, and forecasts a rolling one as a ghost
Peekaboo Moles debut in Level 2 wave 5 with their hint, three hills and a hidden mole, and come back in L2 W7, L2 W9 and L4 W6
A hidden mole rumbles under hill floor(hash01(G, 0) * 3) from .5 s, pops up there at 1.2 s, ducks and moves on
A seed that meets a hill while the mole hides bounces off it (molehill:guard, no refund); chains, powers and strikes bloom a hill plainly
Bonk: a seed through his hill blooms the mole, then his three hills bloom within .4 s as chains the seed earned
Chains, powers and uncredited strikes reach the mole even underground and bloom him plainly, with no bonk
The no-dive rule: low on the board (y + 10 > 360) or with no other open hill, he stays up
Every hill chain-bloomed while he hides: he rumbles .7 s where the last one was, pops up there and stays up
A mole plays out the same at 30, 60 and 144 FPS, a Lullaby holds his dance still, and his group costs one life
The bot sees a hidden mole once his rumble is public: hidden until rumbleUntil, his hill a ghost from then; hills are -1, a mole +30
foes.js never touches the seed pod and never uses Math.random
